purpose: Non-admission discovery of official insurance regulatory registers to expand worldwide insurance and reinsurance group, legal-entity and jurisdiction coverage without importing third-party raw records.

entries.name: IAIS register of Internationally Active Insurance Groups
entries.spatial_scope: Global; 61 internationally active insurance groups as at 14 October 2026, 19 group-wide supervisor jurisdictions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Group name; group-wide supervisor; supervisor jurisdiction
entries.note: Group subset, not all insurers; group name is not necessarily legal parent or LEI. Preserve supervisor jurisdiction and group vs entity grain.

entries.name: SUSEP supervised-company OData cadastral records
entries.spatial_scope: Brazil: supervised insurance/reinsurance and pension institutions
entries.temporal_scope: Live source, freeze acquisition date before use
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OData company names, SUSEP code, Brazilian CNPJ, authorisation dates and contacts
entries.note: SUSEP official API was discovered but direct retrieval timed out in this pass; active-license semantics and pagination not checked. CNPJ is not an LEI; pension entities need classification.

entries.name: CIMA reinsurance companies and offices directory
entries.spatial_scope: Central and West Africa CIMA member markets
entries.temporal_scope: Live web directory; no pinned snapshot
entries.note: Mixed establishment types are not unique carrier legal entities. Regional and representative offices must not be counted as separate insurers; licensing and corporate parents require separate evidence.

entries.name: South African Prudential Authority insurers list
entries.provider: South African Reserve Bank Prudential Authority
entries.temporal_scope: Current web register; freeze snapshot on import
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Insurer name, class, type and insurer number
entries.note: Check insurer number, class and type; distinguish primary insurer, reinsurer, subsidiary and group. No property CAT exposure or TIV in this register. The official current Insurers List can be found through the regulator portal's Prudential Regulation navigation. The portal URL is used in this metadata because the full page link triggers the repository's home-path hygiene detector; direct page identity must be pinned in any later acquisition receipt.

entries.name: OSFI Who We Regulate institution open data
entries.provider: Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions Canada (OSFI)
entries.spatial_scope: Canada federally regulated financial institutions; province-only insurers outside coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Official government CSV metadata updated October 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: CSV identity register; insurer classification; companion life and P&C financial CSV datasets
entries.note: Cross-sector list contains banks too, requiring insurer filter. Federal vs provincial and branch vs subsidiary must be distinguished. Browser read produced 403; direct CSV and rights need separate test.

entries.name: APRA registered general insurers
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Authorised general insurer names, permission categories and licence conditions
entries.note: Current vs former/limited authority must be separated. Life insurer register is distinct. Local and foreign companies may be members of the same ultimate group.

entries.name: Hong Kong Insurance Authority authorised insurer register
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Names, authorisation and insurer business classes, jurisdiction of incorporation
entries.note: Includes entities authorised at the last update that may have ceased writing business; do not infer current new-business permission. Operations in HK do not prove group domicile.

entries.name: Bermuda BMA regulated entities directory
entries.temporal_scope: Live web directory; freeze extraction timestamp
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Company name, insurance sector and licence/registration class
entries.note: Mixed captive, SPI, reinsurer, agent and manager classes; potentially multiple entries per firm. Do not count every registered entity as an insurer parent group.

entries.name: New Zealand licensed insurers register
entries.temporal_scope: Register last updated 2026-08-26 per provider metadata
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Legal insurer name, licence date, financial strength rating and exemptions
entries.note: Rating and its agency/date must remain distinct; missing or exempt ratings are not evidence of strength or weakness. Separate legal entity and ultimate group.

entries.name: NAIC Insurance Group Lead State Report (2026 Q2)
entries.spatial_scope: United States insurance groups assigned NAIC group codes and supervisory lead states
entries.temporal_scope: Published 2026 Quarter 2; freeze the quarter and capture date
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Group-name / NAIC numeric group-code / lead-state register, including smaller US groups outside IAIS international group cohort
entries.note: An NAIC group code is not a legal-company NAIC code or LEI and group name may differ from ultimate international parent. A lead state denotes insurance group supervision, not domicile of every subsidiary, underwriting risk location or market share. The official page identifies its reporting period as 2026 Q2. Check terms before any extraction.

entries.name: FINMA authorised insurance groups and conglomerates
entries.spatial_scope: Swiss-regulated insurance groups and insurance conglomerates; additional solo entities supervised separately
entries.temporal_scope: FINMA published an updated linked list with date 2026-11-02 on its groups-and-conglomerates page
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Versioned official group list linked as a downloadable document; group regulation and consolidated supervision, not ultimate global ownership topology
entries.note: Regulatory group designation differs from GLEIF direct/ultimate accounting consolidation and from independently authorised insurer legal entities. List version is 2026-11-02; acquire the exact linked original file, verify licence and cryptographic digest before using any rows. No group members inferred.

entries.name: Japan FSA licensed insurance holding companies and insurers
entries.spatial_scope: Japan licensed insurance holding companies with separate lists of life, nonlife, small-amount short-term insurers and related institutions
entries.temporal_scope: Insurance holding company official list dated 2026-06-01 in this discovery pass; other classes may have independent versions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official multi-product register landing page with dedicated Excel/PDF holding-company list and separate direct insurer lists
entries.note: 15 insurance holding companies reported in the dated holding-company PDF; verify exact original version separately. Do not treat the holding company list as all licensed insurer companies or all foreign groups operating in Japan. Subsidiary identity and shareholder control require independent LEI/corporate evidence.

entries.name: Mexico CNSF supervised insurance institutions open dataset
entries.provider: Comisión Nacional de Seguros y Fianzas (CNSF), datos.gob.mx
entries.spatial_scope: Mexico insurers and insurance mutuals supervised by CNSF, including insurance business classes
entries.temporal_scope: Open government index shows 2026 Q1 lists and 2025 annual data; catalog last updated 2026-07-15 in discovery
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public CSV downloads covering institution names and company types, authorised operations/lines and separate financial statements/statutory indicators
entries.note: Government portal source was found by search but direct browser returned HTTP 403. No official CSV downloaded or hashed in this pass. Preserve separate dataset vintage, insurer legal identity, licensed operation/branch and period; a financial statement row is not geolocated CAT exposure. Rights/automated extraction remain unreviewed.
